name: SikaTile-440 Opti-Cure
paste:
SIKATILE®-440 OPTI-CURE: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: SikaTile®-440 Opti-Cure, April 2024, Version 01.01 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/2/sikatile-440-opti-cure.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide SikaTile®-440 Opti-Cure where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2024, Version 01.01).
1.2 Product description.
    - SikaTile®-440 Opti-Cure is a multi-purpose rapid setting cement-based tile and stone adhesives with patented DUST LESS® technology which reduces airborne dust in the mixing phase by up to 80%, improving air quality, less mess and faster clean up.
    - SikaTile®-440 Opti-Cure rapid setting formulation is suitable for grouting and light foot traffic after 2-3 hours (timing impacted by climate and environment).
    - SikaTile®-440 Opti-Cure unique formulation is suitable for laying most types of tiles, natural stone, agglomerates, terrazzo, and man made stone.
    - SikaTile®-440 Opti-Cure is exceptionally smooth and creamy to spread with high performance non slump capabilities for large format tile and stone applications
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. SikaTile®-440 Opti-Cure can be used for thin-bed tile and stone applications and medium-bed applications up to 10m bed thickness. SikaTile®-440 Opti-Cure is suitable for wall and floor applications both internal and externally. Suitable tile types include.
    - Ceramic and porcelain tiles.
    - Glass tiles and mosaics
    - Natural Stone* including marble, granite, limestone, basalt etc
    - Agglomerates*, terrazzo* and man made stone*
    - Class A & B tested stone* in accordnace with EN14617-12
    *Sika recomends conducting a site test to evaluate compatability of the stone witht the adhesive due to influences beyond Sika's control.
1.4 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer - Suitable substrates include.
    - Concrete
    - Cement-based screeds and renders
    - Compressed cement boards*
    - Cement sheeting*/Ceramic Tile underlay*
    - Existing tiles with SikaTile 015 Prep n Prime
    - Light weight construction boards suitable for tiling applications*
    - Suitable Sika under tile waterproofing membranes
    - Under tile heating systems
    - Gypsum plasterboard (internal only)
    - Sika approved acoustic underlayments *refer to board manufacture instructions for further details and laod limits.
1.5 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.9.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. SikaTile®-440 Opti-Cure
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: A RAPID SETTING TILE AND STONE ADHESIVE WITH PATENTED DUST LESS® TECHNOLOGY
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2024, Version 01.01) has no approvals, certificates or standards section.
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - EN14617-12: cited elsewhere in the data sheet. Where: Uses (p.1).
    - AS ISO 13007: cited with a stated property or value. Where: Product Information > Product declaration (p.2).
    - AS 3958: referred to in instructions or limitations. Where: Application Instructions > APPLICATION (p.3); Application Instructions > SUBSTRATE QUALITY (p.2).
    - AS3958: referred to in instructions or limitations. Where: Application Instructions > APPLICATION (p.3).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Rapid setting, ready for grouting and light foot traffic after 2-3 hours.
    - Patented DUST LESS® Technology that reduces airborne dust in the mixing phase by up to 80%
    - C2TFS1 flexible performance
    - Smooth creaming formulation for ease application
    - Suitable for ealy aged screeds
    - Exceptional non slump properties making it suitable for fixing large format tile and stone.
    - Low VOC
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Product declaration: C2TFS1 as per AS ISO 13007.
    - Appearance and colour: white to cream colour
2.6 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 20kg Bags
    - Shelf life: 9 months from date of manufacture if unopened.
    - Storage conditions: Store in dry, cool conditions, out of direct sunlight. High humidity will reduce shelf life.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 General. Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2024, Version 01.01) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.
3.2 Substrate quality.
    - Substrate deflection: all substrates under loads must not exceed L/360 for tile & L/720 for stone applications.
    - Substrates must be properly cured, structurally sound, free from friable particles, clean, dry, and free from contaminates such as dirt, dust, oil, curing compounds, laitance or efflorescence.
    - Dependant on the substrate condition and contamination to be removed from the surface, perform adequate preparation techniques such as water blasting, scarification etc to remove all traces of contaminates.
    - For tiling wet areas, a suitable Sika approved waterproof membrane shall be used prior to tiling and allow to dry prior to application.
    Concrete Floors: Allow 28 days for concrete to cure. Concrete shall be left with an open surface - steel trowel finishes are generally acceptable if they accept water. Remove all traces of curing compound, surface sealers, dirt, oil, and any other contaminate that may inhibit the adhesion.
    Cement -based Screeds: Must be installed as per AS 3958 The installation of ceramic and stone tiles Sheeted substrates: All boards / underlays must be installed as per the manufacturer's instructions and specifically designed for tiling.
3.3 Substrate preparation.
    - All substrates shall be primed with a suitable Sika primer.
    - Do not prime over waterproofing membranes, apply the adhesive directly over the membrane. Porous substrates: SikaTile 010 Secure Prime
    - Non porous substrates: SikaTile 015 Prep n Prime. Refer to specific instructions on primer product datasheets.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2024, Version 01.01) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Mixing ratio: 5 - 5.5 litres of water per 20kg bag
    - Pot Life: 45 minutes at 23°C & 50% relative humidity. Restirring the adhesive during its pot life may be required.
    - Open Time: 20 minutes, at 23°C & 50% relative humidity. Measured in laboratory conditions.
4.3 Consumption.
    - Consumption is dependent on substrate surface profile, and application technique use chart as a guide only.
    | Notched Troewl Size | Approximate coverage |
    | 6mm | 8-9m² |
    | 10mm | 5-6m² |
4.4 Applied product ready for use.
    - Values determined at laboratory conditions 23°C & 50% RH. Higher temperatures will reduce times and lower temperatures will increase times.
    | USE | WAIT TIME |
    | Grouting or foot traffic | 2-4 hours |
    | Return to wet area service | 24 hours |
4.5 Equipment.
    - Clean mixing buckets
    - Mixing drill with stirrer attachment
    - Notched trowels
4.6 Mixing. Pour cool clean water into a clean mixing pail before slowly adding the adhesive powder. Mix with a mixing driller with stirrer attachment for approximately 2-3 minutes to achieve a smooth lump free homogenous mixture. Allow the mixture to stand for 2 minutes then restir for an additional minute without adding any water. Restirring the mixture may be necessary during the pot life of the adhesive.
4.7 Application.
    - All tiles and stone shall be fixed in accordance with relevant AS 3958 The installation of ceramic and stone tiles.
    - Ensure the backs of tiles and clean and free from dust and contaminates prior to laying.
    - Apply the adhesive to the substrate with the appropriately sized notched trowel to achieve minimum coverage requirements.
    - Ensure large tiles and all stone are back-buttered with the adhesive to ensure full coverage is achieved in accordance with AS3958.
    - Apply the adhesive in a single direction. While pressing the tile or stone into the wet adhesive, break the ridges with the tile to fully bed the tile into the adhesive.
    - Allow adhesive to dry and set prior to grouting.
    - It is advisable to periodically check the backs of tiles to ensure adequate coverage is achieved in accordance with the standards.
4.8 Cleaning of equipment. Tools and equipement can be cleaned with water while the adhesive is still wet.
4.9 Limitations and important considerations.
    - SikaTile® 440 Opti-Cure is not suitable for use over timber or particle board substrates, over sheet with a suiable tile underlays or install a reinforce screed.
    - Not suitable for use over solvent based coating or waterproofing membranes.
    - The performance of cement based materials will be comprimissed when used below 5°C and above 35°C.
    - It is recommended in hot climates to regularly clean mixing pails in between adhesive mixes and to ensure cool or cold water is used when mixing the adhesive to maximise potlife and open time.
    - It is recomended to conduct a test sample for compatability when fixing tile and stone subject to moisture or dimensional stability.
    - Not suitable for direct fixing of resin back tile and stone, prime the resin with SikaTile 015 Prep n Prime first and allow to dry prior to fixing with SikaTile®- 440 Opti-Cure.
    - Do not use with tiles and stone subject to moisture or dimensionaly stabilty over early aged screeds or early aged concrete.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions stated in the limitations. Also stated in the data sheet limitations (clause 4.9):
    - The performance of cement based materials will be comprimissed when used below 5°C and above 35°C.
    - It is recomended to conduct a test sample for compatability when fixing tile and stone subject to moisture or dimensional stability.
    - Do not use with tiles and stone subject to moisture or dimensionaly stabilty over early aged screeds or early aged concrete.
5.3 Trials, test areas and compatibility checks stated by the manufacturer.
    - It is recomended to conduct a test sample for compatability when fixing tile and stone subject to moisture or dimensional stability.
5.4 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.5 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: SikaTile®-440 Opti-Cure, April 2024, Version 01.01, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/2/sikatile-440-opti-cure.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS SikaTile® 440 Opti-Cure, version 17/11/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/g/sds-sikatile-440opti-cure.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. Please refer to the latest edition of the Material Safety Datasheet for safe handling requirements.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
